parsed.degree_signal: Master’s, or PhD in a relevant field
parsed.notes:
The explicit ideal-candidate sentence in THE ROLE is treated as a candidate qualification, not merely a responsibility; it makes protein design, mass spectrometry/docking pipelines, LLMs, agents, and scientific workflow automation required.
Preferred Qualifications makes its technical items nice_to_have; the closing invitation to apply without every qualification does not change those labels.
Slash-separated framework/tool examples for a single ask are treated as alternatives. AWS services are complementary infrastructure components, not one interchangeable set. Groups containing only one taxonomy-mapped skill are omitted.
Unmapped alternatives include mass spec/docking pipelines, DVC/LakeFS, Terraform/CDK, diffusion/flow/VAEs, gnina/DiffDock, and Redshift/Snowflake; unmapped entries have no skill IDs or group fields.
Proteomics, biophysics, ADMET, degree fields, and application domains are excluded as domain knowledge; explicitly named technical methods such as molecular dynamics and protein modeling are retained.
Argo is not mapped to Argo CD, and workflow orchestration is not mapped to LLM orchestration. Generic databases and ML frameworks have no exact taxonomy entries.
